reviews.text: Professional team with affordable services.

In September, our dog Archer underwent surgery for a torn ligament by Dr. Péter Makai. We were given detailed information, we were there with the dog while he fell asleep and when he woke up after surgery. I can't even tell you how much this meant to us. The surgery took place within two days of the injury, since it's a border collie, which is also a huge plus. The dog took the surgery well mentally, which we will never be able to thank him for. The stitches were removed by a young doctor, in a very professional manner, I have never seen a doctor sit down on the floor with the dog. I can only recommend them, hats off to the staff. Thank you again.

Today I took my dog ​​to get vaccinated. I made an appointment for 10am.. I checked out of the reception before 10am that we were here.. They didn't call me in until 8pm and when I told the receptionist that we were giving up and I couldn't keep my 55kg dog here, they called me in. Dr. Laura didn't even look at us, she was on the phone, the assistant did the data entry and the vaccination... (thanks to the assistant for her work) but I don't know what's wrong with Dr. Laura, she's not even able to greet or talk to the patients...

We were here about 2 years ago with our cat Füge, and yesterday we were also with our cat Áfonya, with whom we came for a heart ultrasound. Our veterinarian recommended this clinic both times. Both times life brought us to Dr. Noémi Szilágyi.
The doctor and her “team” are incredibly enthusiastic, caring, helpful and prepared.. almost like a fairy tale.

The only negative is the parking space, but regardless, the 5⭐️ remains

We recommend the clinic wholeheartedly!

Yesterday, Sunday, I waited for 1 hour (we were inside for about 8 minutes). I had to come back today because my dog ​​got worse, I think from the medicine he was given. I've been waiting for over 1 hour now. The person I came to had finished his work hours. I'm a bit grumpy!

We specifically came to Dr. Dalma Péterfia for a cardiac ultrasound because we had read a lot of good things about the Doctor. We were not disappointed: the Doctor treated our Zsemik and us, the owners, with infinite humanity, understanding, kindness and expertise. I am sincerely grateful to her and her assistant for helping our puppy get better. The two of them practically saved our puppy's life! In addition, she took care of the further steps, which we only had to follow "blindly". I can only recommend her, a true, conscientious professional.

To Dr. Makai only and specifically.
We have been going for seven years, first with my cat, then with my dog, and I have only positive, very good experiences. He does not operate unnecessarily, or, if the negative results were more than positive, that was the case with my cat.
And he operated on my dog ​​so professionally, with a femoral head, that anyone who does not know, would not even notice at first. Since then, we go to him anytime to see him, examine him, he never puts an unnecessary burden on the owner, and he is very precise.
If it is an orthopedic problem, then only he. 🙏

My dog ​​was limping on his right hind leg, I took him to another clinic when he was still a puppy, they did an X-ray and determined that he had hip dysplasia. He received cartilage reinforcements, then at 5 and a half years old his leg started to hurt, that's when they recommended the Minivet clinic and the orthopedic doctor, Dr. Péter Makai. The doctor determined with a visual examination and an X-ray that the dog's tibia was crooked and the kneecap had popped out of place, which was causing the problem. The surgeries were successful, although the recovery took a long time, the dog happily runs after his balls. Thank you to the employees of Minivet, everyone was very helpful and friendly. Thank you again to Dr. Makai, I recommend the clinic to everyone.

I thank God that in 2024 I was recommended Minivet and Dr. Péter Makai, who perfectly fixed my dog's leg with a complex TPLO surgery. He was always correct and helpful, and he still is to this day, I can only recommend him to everyone! Since then, if we have any problems, I feel free to contact them. (Umbilical hernia, tartar)

We have been coming here for a very long time, with our dog and cat. My husband has been here since about 2000, and I have been here "only" since 2011. They have excellent, well-trained veterinarians, they are kind, and it is a special pleasure that Bíró Joli works at the reception, because she is also very kind and knowledgeable.

Seriously, are you giving 1 star because you have to wait and your favorite person doesn't smile? So if the office was empty because no one wanted to go there "for anything", would it be 5 stars? I've never had a bad experience in the past 15 years.

I am very grateful to them! We have been going there for 4 years, they are always very attentive and precise, I can only recommend them. The opening hours are a special bonus.
/
Update:
Unfortunately, we had to put our beloved cat to sleep. They were very humane and kind. Dr. Laura does everything she can to make sure my cat can be with me as long as possible. And in the end, she does everything she can for us. Fortunately, they work with a family that deals with cremation, so they were able to help with this. I can only recommend them. Thank you for giving us several more years to be together with Poco and the kitten thanks to their work.

Professional expertise.
Within 2 weeks, they were the 4th veterinary clinic I visited in desperation due to my 13-year-old cat being seriously ill and they immediately gave me the correct diagnosis (unfortunately, he had to be put down, due to a metastatic tumor).
After numerous examinations, the first 3 places gave conflicting opinions, which prolonged my cat's suffering.

For the Kisállat Ultrahang Clinic

I am deeply grateful to Dr. Dalma Peterfia and the entire team for saving my 2-month-old puppy’s life. She was diagnosed with PDA and was in a very critical condition when we arrived. Thanks to Dr. Dalma’s professionalism, dedication, and effort, she received the care she urgently needed and was given a real chance at life.
I cannot express enough how thankful I am for everything she did — not only for her medical expertise, but also for the compassion and commitment she showed during such a frightening time. Thanks to her, my little puppy is here today.
I highly recommend Dr. Dalma Peterfia and truly appreciate all the effort she put into saving her.

My dog ​​needed a tumor removed and they were recommended by my vet. I am completely satisfied with the service they provided, they are conscientious and the price is very fair.

My dog's surgery was successful and everything went as they said. I recommend them to everyone. Thank you Minivet!😊
Thank you.....

It's been a long time since I've met such a humane and thorough veterinarian. Dr. Péter Makai examined our dog's leg and explained everything in such detail and patiently that we immediately felt at ease. It's clear that he truly cares about both the animal and the owner. An extraordinary experience, I highly recommend it!!!
They provided our lab with the utmost expertise. Thank you!

Dear Timea!
Thank you for your opinion.
It would have helped a lot if you could describe in a few words what is bothering you.
The crowded parking lot, the patients who showed up in the waiting room besides you, the quality of the care, maybe the price of the clinic....
Happy New Year!!
Minivet

If I could, I wouldn't give it a star, their super vets almost managed to kill my cat... We took him to them for 3 days, they refused to do any tests, despite our begging and saying that the money didn't matter, just do something (no blood tests, no temperature readings, nothing) and we are talking about a completely calm cat, he doesn't scratch, doesn't bite, etc... they just kept giving him injections. On the fourth day, I managed to beg for a blood sugar test and a temperature reading, as our cat's condition was constantly deteriorating, he wasn't even eating anymore, my husband said that they couldn't give him any more injections, just print out his medical records so we could see what injections he had received and in what quantity, so we could go to a normal vet, where the point isn't just to drag people in as many times as possible so they can squeeze as much money out of him as possible. There is no such thing in the medical records, nor the exact name of the drug that was administered, only the active ingredient, but the dosage is not indicated there either. After this treatment, another veterinarian determined that our cat's kidneys had completely failed due to the irresponsible medication, we took her for several weeks for an infusion course, and then we went to a nephrologist specialist for months, thanks to whom our cat survived the irresponsible medication. Unfortunately, I did not take the appropriate legal steps at the time, even though they deserved it, we did not receive an invoice for any treatment, and the names of their doctors do not appear on any paper, I think it was no coincidence. The cat's original problem: she fell down the stairs and hurt her leg, I begged to have an X-ray, I specifically asked for an appointment to have an X-ray, it never happened. They saw that I was already 5 months pregnant, but I still sat outside in the waiting room for hours almost every time, even though no one was in front of us. It cost us about 300-400,000 HUF to let our cat survive the “treatment” here, and since then he has only been able to eat renal tap and we have to constantly medicate him, which is about 50,000 HUF per month, of course I am happy to pay this, because the main thing is that he survived. (The cat’s blood count was checked 2-3 weeks ago at another clinic for an annual check-up, and his kidneys were completely fine, so overmedication was definitely the problem) We were at the beginning of the 5th month, and by now I dare say that our cat is starting to regain his old good mood and appetite, that maybe we are finally over the difficult part and with proper maintenance he will be fine. If you can, take your animal somewhere else, because these are not doctors, only money matters, not the animal…

We are satisfied with the professional staff every time.
However, the receptionist's attitude and communication leave something to be desired.
We overheard a worried, politely interested owner being laughed at out loud for daring to show up without an appointment at the suggestion of his veterinarian.
Grimacing and grimacing are also not very professional behavior.

We were there a week ago with our cat, although we had to wait a long time and come back several times because the cat didn't get better, we received a completely satisfactory answer every time we went there. We got help and a week later he got better because he had caught some virus. They were also willing to examine our cat at the last minute on the weekend.
We are extremely satisfied in every area (orthopedics, general medicine, dentistry, etc.) And, I would like to emphasize that they are also available on weekends!!!

I waited for 1 hour, the animals just kept pouring in, before I could talk to a person, and he just told me to wait. We were only going for a 2-minute vaccination. Bad work organization, no agility, sloppy work. Hey, this is not a state system, and it's not TB EÜ, people pay here. If I don't need my money, I'll look for another place, but I'm an hour behind.
There is no weekend service! The phone was not answered, there is no information about this on the website!
Shouldn't it be written that you're not open after 7pm? I'm sorry about the website management.

Thank you for sharing your opinion.
Our practice was closed on the given weekend. We announced this several days in advance on our Facebook page and in person at the practice, but we acknowledge that our website was not updated, so we apologize for the inconvenience this may cause.

It is important to us that our patients always receive accurate information, so in the future we will also try to notify you on our website if there is a change in opening hours. 
Thank you for your understanding

I was with my cat today, although she no longer showed symptoms when we got there, they took her seriously, took an accurate history and examined her very thoroughly by Dr. Kiss-Szilvási, and just to be safe, the cat was given an anti-inflammatory. The doctor and the assistant lady were both kind, and the cat was treated very routinely. The treatment fee, including the emergency fee, was fair. Thank you!

Dr. Dalma Péterfia treated our aging cat for cardiology a few years ago. The doctor treated both the pet and the owner with infinite humanity, understanding, kindness and expertise. I am sincerely grateful to her and her assistants for helping our cat get better despite her long-term illness and be with us. I can only recommend her, she is a true, conscientious professional.
Minivet Thank you for the fast and precise work, even though we had my Mini Yorkie Ficánka spayed and neutered before, who is a very small dog compared to the one he is half a year old.

Dr. Makai examined our limping dog Bobó, explained the problem thoroughly, and drew it for me. The situation does not require any further treatment or intervention at this time. The Dr. was very kind and patient.

I went there with a big panic that my puppy's leg was suspected to be infected
The doctor was kind and helpful! A thousand thanks and gratitude.!

Huge gratitude and thanks to the team!

We visited the clinic on Saturday.
Dr. Laura Kiss-Szilvási was on duty. After a short wait, they called us in!

A kind, attentive doctor examined our 14-year-old dog, Artúr!
We arrived with a suspicion of a right hind knee injury. She did not detect a fracture or more serious injury, but she recommended that we make an appointment for an orthopedic examination.
We called them on Monday morning. They saw us that afternoon!
We thank Dr. Péter Makai for his thorough and comprehensive examination!
Extremely patient and humane!

We can only recommend Minivet!

Thank you very much!

Dear MINIVET! We would like to thank you for your prompt and prompt response. Our dog had a tick near his eye and I was afraid I wouldn't be able to remove it properly. I called the clinic this Sunday and they said they wouldn't even charge an emergency fee in this case. They treated us very humanely. They called us in right away and were very kind. I can only recommend them to everyone 🫶🏻🙏🏼

They drove away with a drowning puppy!!!
They didn't treat him!!!
By the time we got to the other doctor, he was dead!!!

We had been dealing with the problem with the dog for 4 months and made almost no progress. My dog ​​was diagnosed superficially, in fact, around the 2nd month, I was told that it was all my fault. The only person who dealt with it was the one we started the treatment with, another doctor didn't really talk to him, they didn't want to get involved. I went elsewhere, based on what I was told, he immediately listed 3 possibilities for what could be wrong, we are on the second one and there is a clear improvement.
However, it is worth highlighting that they helped us quickly arrange more specialized treatments (in our case, ultrasound).

Absolutely kind and helpful :)
I can recommend them in every way

Since the "change" they have been quite negative towards people, saying that the dog will recover at home, so it's really good, dear commenter, that you don't see the negative comments as well-founded, if you've read them and asked questions like a journalist, but I think there are a few things to criticize here!
Thank you..

Huge gratitude and thanks to the Minivet Veterinary Clinic team! ❤️🐾

We arrived at them unknown, but we immediately felt that we were in the best hands. The professional team of the clinic – the doctors and the assistant – helped our sick dog not only with their expertise, but also with their incredible kindness and love. She received all the care and attention she needed to recover.

We feel indescribable gratitude that such wonderful people took care of Maya!

If you are looking for a reliable, heart-and-soul veterinary team, Minivet is the best choice! ❤️🐶✨
Quick appointment, professional care, great doctors and assistants.
Doctor Makai's medical and human attitude is top notch! Best orthopedic doctor!
thank you

I've been coming here for years, but I was very disappointed this time.
A lady who knocked on the door in a rude manner got in before everyone else, I'd been sitting outside for 2.5 hours. When I asked her, the doctor said that she had spoken to me on the phone, and that it wouldn't be a problem, since there were urgent cases. But in the waiting room, she talked to her partner about not waiting their turn and that they would solve it in a smart way...
They succeeded.
The biggest mistake was that we didn't come here first with our dog Terka, who has a heart condition. I can only recommend Dr. Dalma Péterfia, a woman with expertise, humanity, empathy.

Dear MINIVET!
Today was our first time at your place, but we will definitely come back here with our little Molly dog ​​😁 …

We have been coming here with our cats for 14 years. They were always able to help. If they couldn't do something, they redirected us to a place that could (e.g. They couldn't do an X-ray right away, or a cat with cancer needed to be …
There's nothing better than clicking 1 star for no reason, just for fun.....
